stance_rationale: The draft already admits graduation failure, but the stronger rejection reason is upstream PIT contamination: Phase 1/3 factor selection used post-lockbox IC history through 2026-02, then v3.7 revalidated the inherited Top12 as if candidate selection were clean. Reported DSR and Harvey evidence also do not survive the true 269-factor plus Phase3 method-search denominator.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: outputs/v3_7/alpha_scores.parquet is multi-date, but factor weights are one full-sample ICIR vector applied to all dates; mandated qepm/stage_artifacts path is stale v3.6 with 83 dates.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: v3_7 script uses Z_Score_Aligned via load_month_factors and no NEGATE_FACTORS/FLIP_SIGN pattern was found.
factor_db_202311.parquet has no Usable_Date column; load_month_factors cannot prove row-level Usable_Date <= sig_date for factor values.
emitted factors use connector, but Phase1/Phase3 selection lineage relies on direct factor_ic/phase parquet artifacts rather than a cutoff-safe load_month_factors-only path.
v3.7 TOP3 alpha has no regime/overlay component.
Final selected TOP3 factors are price/return derived, not financial-statement factors.

critical_concerns.description: Phase1/Phase3 candidate selection is not PIT: factor_db_untapped_icir_ranking.meta.json ends at 2026-02 and phase3 selected Top-K by recent 5Y ICIR before the v3.7 pre-cutoff revalidation. This leaks the 2024 lockbox into hypothesis selection. [PIT-C1, AX-002, RF-A6]

The alpha score uses one static ICIR-proportional factor-weight vector derived from the full 226-date validation sample and applies it to every historical sig_date; early alpha rows therefore depend on future IC information. [PIT-C1, AX-002, RF-A7]

Multiple-testing control is understated: DSR uses n_trials=18, but the actual search includes 269 Factor DB candidates, Phase1 Top30, Phase3 38 candidates, orthogonal Top-K, and several composites. Harvey also passes only 2/5 specs. [RF-A6, AX-002]
The signal fails economically important alpha shape tests: bad/normal IC ratio is -0.211, crisis IC is negative, monotonicity is -0.261, and D10-D1 is only 0.03%/month. [AX-001, RF-A6]
Liquidity was not enforced PIT: historical top decile has 340/7001 rows below the 2e8 won hard floor and 153 below 1e8; top20 has 278/4540 rows below 2e8. [PIT-C10, RF-A5]
AX-007 is not resolved by saying the optimizer may create multi-sleeves later; the draft reports top20 long-only metrics without proving a permitted exception. [AX-007, L-484]

Current root challenge_note.md, risk/optimization packages, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet are absent; the specified qepm/stage_artifacts alpha package is stale v3.6, not the v3.7 draft. [AX-008, RF-A7]

supporting_arguments: The v3.7 alpha_scores file itself is multi-date with 227 monthly dates, 2005-01-31 to 2023-11-30, and no future sig_date beyond today.
Rank IC, ICIR, and subperiod stability clear their numeric gates before correcting for selection leakage.
Sector-neutral retention for the selected TOP3 factors is above 50%, so RF-A4 is not the primary failure.
unresolved_disputes: Recompute Phase1/Phase3 candidate selection with lockbox sealed at 2023-12-22 and prove the same TOP3 survives.
Replace static full-sample ICIR weights with rolling or expanding weights available at each sig_date.
Recalculate DSR/Harvey using the full research search denominator, not n_trials=18.
Produce current v3.7 challenge_note.md, artifact mirror, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet or mark them infeasible explicitly.
Apply PIT t-1 20d TV >= 2e8 liquidity before IC and top20/topdecile diagnostics.
weakest_assumption: The weakest claim is that pre-cutoff v3.7 revalidation cures a TOP12 candidate list selected using Phase1/Phase3 IC evidence through 2026-02.
rebuttal_required: Show cutoff-safe Phase1/Phase3 artifacts whose date_end is <= 2023-12-22.
Show per-sig_date factor weights computed only from prior data.
Show corrected DSR with all 269 Factor DB candidates and Phase3/composite trials counted.
Show PIT liquidity-filtered IC, monotonicity, and top20 metrics under the 2e8 won hard floor.
Provide the missing current challenge note and artifact lineage for v3.7.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Claude's draft reaches TERMINATE, but it underweights the stronger external objection: the candidate-generation lineage itself appears lockbox-contaminated and the current artifact set is not triangulation-complete.
